definition: Elapsed time within recording session (HH:MM:SS). Resets at 00:00:00 for each file.
Elapsed time converted to integer seconds. Used for time-series indexing.
Original Excel filename this row was loaded from.
Excel sheet name this row was loaded from.
Date inferred from filename (DDMMYY pattern). Not verified against aircraft records.
Aircraft model identifier. Value 'S76A/C+' = Sikorsky S-76A/C+.
Engine 1 Gas Generator (N1/Nf) speed. Normal cruise ~107%. Values >120% are fault sentinels.
Engine 2 Gas Generator (N1/Nf) speed. Normal cruise ~68% (one engine powering rotor).
Engine 2 Nf duplicate channel present in some files. Relationship to E2NF_S76C unverified.
Engine 1 Torque. Normal cruise 40–90%. Values >130% are fault sentinels.
Engine 2 Torque. Normal cruise 40–90%.
Engine 1 Oil Pressure warning flag. On = warning active.
Engine 2 Oil Pressure warning flag. On = warning active.
Main Transmission Oil Pressure warning flag.
Main Transmission Oil Temperature warning flag.
Main Rotor Speed. Normal 100%. Values >115% are fault sentinels.
Rotor Brake engaged flag.
Pressure Altitude. Normal range −300 to ~10 000 ft. Value −16 300 = sensor invalid sentinel.
Magnetic Heading. 0–360°.
Indicated Airspeed. Vne ~155 kn. Values >200 kn are fault sentinels.
Airspeed valid flag (On/Off string). Separate from numeric Indicated_Airspeed.
Outside Air Temperature. Normal −40 to +55°C. Values ±~530 are fault sentinels.
Battery Overtemperature warning flag.
Hydraulic System 1 Pressure warning flag.
Hydraulic System 2 Pressure warning flag.
Hydraulic Selector 1 position.
Hydraulic Selector 2 position.
Aircraft pitch angle. ±180° range in raw data; real ±60° for normal operations.
Aircraft roll angle. ±180° range in raw data; real ±60° for normal operations.
